第九章 广阔的胸襟
一声钢铁碰撞声起，脆响的声音传遍每个人的耳内，所有人都瞪大眼睛，看着比剑的结果，就连叶石也不例外。
两柄剑，哪一柄都没有断，这个结果出乎了所有人的意料。世家子弟们，是惊讶惊鸿剑的质地，竟然能在和四品剑争锋之时不断，这剑担得起宝剑之名。而叶石，惊讶的是惊鸿剑竟然没将四品剑劈断？
叶石暗道可惜，如果惊鸿剑能把四品剑劈断，他该有多么好的机会，可以向这些世家公子爷展示自己的忽悠之能，真是可惜了。
世家子弟们也在暗道可惜，没有毁去惊鸿剑，固然说明叶石的剑质地极高，但他们也没有了免费获得宝剑的机会。越是知道宝剑不俗，那想要获得宝剑的想法就越重，心里就像被什么挠着一样，痒的不得了。
唯有张羊大大的松了口气，露出了笑容，别的事情他不管，但大哥没有吃亏，他就高兴了。
就在众人各怀心思，暗自可惜之时，身为当事人的何涌和那名世家子弟，却都闭口不语，身体保持原状，连剑都没有分开。而两人脸上都充满了震惊之色，似乎看见了什么不可思议的事情一般。
叶石最先发现两人的异状，心下一动，朝着两柄剑看去，顿时叶石眼神一亮，露出了会心的笑容。
真是山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村啊，刚刚才见到惊鸿剑没能把四品剑劈断，暗道可惜。现在就见到这样的状况，尽管不比劈断四品剑来得震撼，但这也是一个忽悠世家子弟的机会。
是什么状况让叶石如此开心，让持剑的两人如此震撼呢，答案就在两柄剑的碰撞处上。这时世家子弟们也都一一察觉，仔细观察之下，才惊讶的发现，原来这不是何涌两人不愿意分开，而是两柄剑衔在一起了。
不，严格来说，是惊鸿剑劈裂了四品剑，剑身被卡在了四品剑上。单凭何涌的力气，不足以将两柄剑分开，而且两人此时都处于极度震惊之中，一时没了反应。
“不愧是四品剑，居然能够挡住惊鸿剑的一劈。”叶石赞赏道。
事实上，四品剑是什么，叶石到现在还弄不清楚，但忽悠的话叶石却是张口就来。直接炫耀自己的剑？不，那还不如赞扬四品剑来得更加震撼人心，只要把四品剑说得越好，惊鸿剑劈裂四品剑的情况就越让人印象深刻。
最后，叶石觉得还有些不够，看了世家子弟们一眼，“惊鸿剑居然只是劈裂了它，果然厉害。”
听见叶石这句话，所有人感觉头脑一嗡，刚刚被震惊的脱离了现实，现在又被震惊的拉回了思想。没错，四品剑很强，即便是他们家族，也不是随便就能给他们配置一柄四品剑，但现在不同了。
比起四品剑还要厉害的宝剑，出现在他们面前，只需要花费一笔不菲但绝对不算太离谱的金额，他们就能获得这梦寐以求的宝剑。
这个时候，没有一个人再觉得叶石的剑太贵了，一柄四品剑都绝对值这个价，更别说比起四品剑还要好的宝剑了。
叶石看着世家子弟们平静的目光逐渐被灼热取替，真有种想要给剑都加价的想法，在这个的情况下，加价绝对是大好时机。因为叶石相信，哪怕加价，也阻挡不住这些世家子弟买剑的决心。
只是对于这个美好诱惑，叶石在想起之后立马选择放弃，他可以想象如果自己提出加价，将会迎接什么。这些世家公子爷尽管容易忽悠，但不是那么好欺负的，一旦加价让得他们不爽，派人把这里平了叶石也无处伸冤。
于是，叶石只好继续维持自己的‘光辉形象’，咳嗽一声吸引住所有人的注意，“大家，本店从来秉持一个道理，那就是童叟无欺，今天的剑一律六折。”

叶石这么一说，立刻引起所有的世家子弟叫好起来，这六折可就是省了几十个金币，尽管他们有钱，但也不是这样挥霍的。如果不打折的话，估计一柄剑回去，他们就一清二白了，以后的日子难过。
但这么多人，都六折的话可以想象老板会亏多少，世家子弟们都一脸佩服的看着叶石，就因为一句承诺，真把这么多钱抛出去了，这样多大的决心，多大的毅力，以及多大的信誉。
总之一句话，叶石的人品是一流的，所有人心中想着，哪怕他们身为世家子弟，这时也不由得产生一丝佩服。
谁又知道，叶石压根就没亏过，这些所谓打折的剑，其实都是按照原价格卖个他们的。而叶石甚至还想过提升价格，要不是碍于这些世家公子爷的势力，叶石说什么也要明坑一番。
‘光辉形象’应该有，而且还是大大的有，叶石见众人心生佩服，暗笑一声，又十分正直的道：“其实这些剑里，能和惊鸿剑，巨崛剑相比的只有不到十柄，其余的质地尽管不错，却始终稍有欠缺，所以不能满足各位所有人的需求。”
“什么？”顿时有人惊呼出来，看向身旁伙伴的目光变得有些敌意。
只有不到十柄，他们这里可是足有二十三人，大半的人要空手而归，就连平时交好的朋友，这时也是竞争对手，宝剑在前，就容不得半点情面可讲了。
就连那拿出四品剑的世家子弟，这时也跳了出来，喊道：“我不管，我刚刚毁了一柄四品剑，宝剑我要买下一柄。”
这世家子弟的话倒是没人拒绝，因为这事本就是他们驱使的，所以这事他们也要负点责任，现在人家的四品剑都裂了，怎么也需要给人一个交代。
所以，宝剑又少了一柄，众人间顿时火药味十足，大眼瞪小眼的，看谁都不顺眼。
何涌是看准了惊鸿剑，谁碰他跟谁急，而张羊的巨崛剑，则已经无法再争，又因为四品剑而少了一柄。八柄优质剑具，已经没了三柄。
“放心，在下既然让各位来到本店，就不会落下任何一人。”叶石知道自己当好人的机会来了，微笑一声，用着真诚的语气道：“明天开始我马上开始赶造，把欠缺的宝剑铸造出来。”
“好，叶石大哥说的好。”
“拜托你了，叶石大哥。”
一阵阵称赞声、加油声、佩服声起，每个人都是张开叶石大哥，闭口叶石大哥，那模样，还真像结了拜的异姓兄弟一般。
剩下的五柄剑，被和平的卖了出去，一次性拿到那么多金币，让叶石那个开心啊，就连送走各位世家子弟都是眉开眼笑的。
让所有人心中一阵佩服，损失了这么多钱，竟然还如此开怀，叶石大哥的心胸真是如同大海一样广阔，为我辈之楷模。
所有人都走了，叶石的店铺内总算清净下来，除了叶石外，就只有被叶石留下来的张羊了。
“大哥，你有什么吩咐？”张羊问道。
“不是早说过了吗，等大哥我挣到钱，就给你的巨崛剑回炉加工，让它真正变成一柄宝剑。”叶石笑道。

对于这个给自己带来巨大生意的肥羊，叶石是懂得知恩图报的，尤其是报答之余，还能给自己打造一个活广告、活招牌，叶石自然乐意而为。

Chapter 9 Broad Mind
There was a sound of steel colliding, and the crisp sound spread to everyone's ears. Everyone's eyes widened, watching the result of the sword fight, even Ye Shi was no exception.
Neither of the two swords was broken. This result was beyond everyone's expectations. The disciples of the aristocratic family were surprised that the quality of the Jinghong Sword could actually compete with a fourth-grade sword. This sword could bear the name of a precious sword. As for Ye Shi, he was surprised that the Jinghong Sword didn't break the fourth-grade sword?
Ye Shi secretly thought that it was a pity. If the Jinghong Sword could break the fourth-grade sword, he would have had a great opportunity to show his ability to deceive these young masters. What a pity.
The disciples of the aristocratic family also secretly said that it was a pity that they did not destroy the Jinghong Sword. Although it showed that Ye Shi's sword was of extremely high quality, they also lost the chance to obtain the sword for free. The more he knew that the sword was good, the more he wanted to get the sword. It felt like he was being scratched by something, and it was extremely itchy.
Only Zhang Yang breathed a sigh of relief and smiled. He didn't care about other things, but he was happy because his eldest brother didn't suffer.
While everyone was having their own thoughts and secretly feeling sorry for each other, He Yong and the young man from the aristocratic family who were involved remained silent, their bodies remained in the same position, and they did not even separate their swords. Both of their faces were filled with shock, as if they had seen something incredible.
Ye Shi was the first to notice the strange behavior between the two of them. His heart moved and he looked towards the two swords. Ye Shi's eyes suddenly lit up and he showed a knowing smile.
There is really no way to resolve the doubts, and there is a bright future in the village. I just saw that the Jinghong Sword failed to break the fourth-grade sword, and I secretly thought it was a pity. Seeing such a situation now, although it is not as shocking as breaking a fourth-grade sword, it is also an opportunity to fool the children of the family.
What made Ye Shi so happy and the two sword-holders so shocked? The answer lies in the collision of the two swords. At this time, the disciples of the aristocratic family also noticed one by one. After careful observation, they were surprised to find that it was not that He Yong and He Yong were unwilling to separate, but that the two swords were held together.
No, strictly speaking, it was Jinghong Sword that split the fourth-grade sword, and the sword body got stuck on the fourth-grade sword. He Yong's strength alone was not enough to separate the two swords, and both of them were in extreme shock and had no reaction for a moment.
"As expected of a fourth-grade sword, it can actually block a strike from Jinghong Sword." Ye Shi praised it.
In fact, Ye Shi still doesn't know what the fourth-grade sword is, but Ye Shi just opened his mouth to deceive him. Just show off your sword? No, it would be more shocking to praise the fourth-grade sword. As long as you praise the fourth-grade sword better, the situation of Jinghong Sword splitting the fourth-grade sword will be more impressive.
In the end, Ye Shi felt that it was not enough, and glanced at the disciples of the family, "The Jinghong Sword actually just split it. It is really powerful."
Hearing Ye Shi's words, everyone felt their heads buzzing. They had just been shocked out of reality, and now they were shocked back into their thoughts. Yes, the fourth-grade sword is very strong. Even their family cannot easily equip them with a fourth-grade sword, but it is different now.
A sword that was more powerful than a fourth-grade sword appeared in front of them, and they only needed to spend a large amount of money, but definitely not too outrageous, to get the sword they dreamed of.
At this time, no one thought Ye Shi's sword was too expensive anymore. A fourth-grade sword was definitely worth the price, let alone a sword that was better than a fourth-grade sword.
Ye Shi watched the calm eyes of the disciples of the aristocratic family gradually being replaced by burning enthusiasm. He really had the idea of ​​​​increasing the price of Sword Capital. Under this situation, increasing the price was definitely a good time. Because Ye Shi believed that even if the price increased, it would not stop the determination of these children from aristocratic families to buy swords.
But for this beautiful temptation, Ye Shi immediately chose to give up after thinking about it. He could imagine if he proposedWhat will happen if you increase the price? Although these young masters from aristocratic families are easy to fool, they are not easy to bully. Once the price increase makes them unhappy, Ye Shi will have nowhere to redress his grievances even if he sends people to level the place.
Therefore, Ye Shi had no choice but to continue to maintain his "glorious image" and coughed to attract everyone's attention. "Everyone, our store has always adhered to one principle, that is, no one can be deceived. Today's swords are all 60% off."
When Ye Shi said this, all the children of the aristocratic family immediately cheered. This 40% discount can save dozens of gold coins. Although they have money, they do not squander it like this. If there is no discount, it is estimated that if the sword is returned, they will have a clean slate, and the future will be difficult.
But with so many people, you can imagine how much the boss will lose if they get a 40% discount. The children of the aristocratic family all looked at Ye Shi with admiration. Just because of a promise, he really threw out so much money, with such determination, perseverance, and credibility.
In a word, Ye Shi's character is first-class, everyone thinks in their hearts, even if they are children of aristocratic families, they can't help but feel a little admiration.
Who knew that Ye Shi had never suffered a loss at all. These so-called discounted swords were actually sold to them at the original price. And Ye Shi even thought about raising the price. If it weren't for the power of the young masters of these aristocratic families, Ye Shi would have said anything.
There should be a 'brilliant image', and it should be big. Seeing everyone's admiration, Ye Shi chuckled secretly, and said very honestly: "Actually, among these swords, there are less than ten that can compare with the Jinghong Sword and the Giant Rise Sword. Although the quality of the rest is good, it is always slightly lacking, so it cannot meet everyone's needs."
"What?" Someone suddenly exclaimed, and the eyes he looked at his companions became somewhat hostile.
There were less than ten swords, but there were twenty-three of them here. Most of them had to return empty-handed. Even their usual friends were now competitors. With the sword in front of them, there was no room for any kindness.
Even the son of the aristocratic family who took out the fourth-grade sword jumped out at this time and shouted: "I don't care, I just destroyed a fourth-grade sword, I want to buy another sword."
No one from this aristocratic family refused what they said, because they were the ones driving this matter, so they must bear some responsibility for this matter. Now that their fourth-grade swords are cracked, they still need to give an explanation.
Therefore, the sword was missing again, and the atmosphere among the people suddenly became full of gunpowder, with big eyes and small eyes staring at each other, and no one liked it.
He Yong had his sights set on the Jinghong Sword, and he would be in a hurry with whoever touched him. However, Zhang Yang could no longer compete with the Jinghong Sword, and it was missing one because of the fourth-grade sword. Three of the eight high-quality swords are gone.
"Don't worry, since I let you all come to our store, no one will be left behind." Ye Shi knew that his chance to be a good person had come. He smiled and said in a sincere tone: "Starting tomorrow, I will start working immediately to forge the missing sword."
"Okay, Brother Ye Shi said it well."
"Please, Brother Ye Shi."
There were bursts of praise, cheers, and admiration. Everyone opened their mouths to Brother Ye Shi and closed their mouths to Brother Ye Shi. They really looked like sworn brothers with different surnames.
The remaining five swords were sold peacefully, and he received so many gold coins at once, which made Ye Shi happy. He even smiled when he saw off the children of the aristocratic families.
Everyone was impressed that he was still so happy after losing so much money. Brother Ye Shi's mind is as broad as the sea, and he is a role model for our generation.
Everyone left, and Ye Shi's shop was finally clean. Apart from Ye Shi, the only one left was Zhang Yang, who was left behind by Ye Shi.
"Brother, what are your orders?" Zhang Yang asked.
"Didn't I tell you before? When I make money, brother, I will reprocess your Juriseng Sword., making it truly become a sword. "Ye Shi smiled.
For this fat sheep who brought him huge business, Ye Shi knew how to repay his kindness, especially since he could not only repay the favor, but also create a living advertisement and a living signboard for himself, which Ye Shi was naturally happy to do.
